args.request: Adversarially test the current dealership as a user with very little technical knowledge. Reproduce consequential failures, challenge the interpretation, research bounded alternatives and implement supported improvements locally. Fix name/year search order/spacing with precision controls and source identifier compatibility; recover incompatible game/variant/category filters without erasing available restrictions; preserve usable sidebar/list space with keyboard-operable optional filters; implement native Enter submission, visible provider disclosure and honest cancellation/pending/timeout recovery; correct diagnostic paths and documentation. Preserve unrelated dirty work, independent working models, source assets, compiled catalog and existing vendor/provider dependencies. Save findings, counterevidence, coverage, experiments, decisions and limitations. Review raw diffs against captured dirty task baseline and real current check/browser evidence. No publication authorized; no new execution dependency added. Full suite has72 passing top-level check commands, no top-level skips, and one nested optional Pillow test skipped; the final single-line diagnostic repair has its affected dealership/viewer checks rerun; external/provider, screen-reader, real-device and game-fidelity limits remain explicit. All model disagreements/escalations are preserved and resolved independently where required.
